data.claim: Per RFC 9110 §9.2.1, 'safe' means the operation has no side effects at all (semantically read-only) and 'idempotent' means repeated identical invocations have the same effect as a single one (side effects permitted). An append-only log's writers are neither safe nor idempotent in this strict sense; the log actually requires a weaker informal 'retry-safe' property that neither RFC term captures.
